# 1 Samuel Chapter 10 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 155r-155v | **Source Image:** 1SA_010_page_001.jpg, 1SA_010_page_002.jpg

---

**1** Then Samuel took the flask of oil and poured it on his head and kissed him and said, "Has not the LORD anointed you as ruler over his inheritance?
**2** When you depart from me today, you will find two men by the tomb of Rachel in the territory of Benjamin at Zelzah, and they will say to you, 'The donkeys that you went to seek have been found. And behold, your father has abandoned the matter of the donkeys and is anxious about you, saying, "What shall I do about my son?"'
**3** And you shall pass on from there and beyond, and you shall come to the oak of Tabor, and three men going up to God at Bethel will find you there: one carrying three young goats, and one carrying three loaves of bread, and one carrying a skin of wine.
**4** And they will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, and you shall receive them from their hand.
**5** After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is. And it will be, when you come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place, and before them a harp and a tambourine and a flute and a lyre, and they will be prophesying.
**6** And the spirit of the LORD will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them, and you will be turned into another man.
**7** And it shall be, when these signs come upon you, do for yourself whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you.
**8** And you shall go down before me to Gilgal, and behold, I am coming down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Seven days you shall wait until I come to you, and I will make known to you what you shall do."
**9** And it was so, when he turned his shoulder to depart from Samuel, that God gave him another heart, and all these signs came to pass on that day.
**10** And they came there to the hill, and behold, a band of prophets met him, and the spirit of God rushed upon him, and he prophesied in their midst.
**11** And it came to pass that all who knew him previously saw, and behold, he was prophesying with the prophets. And the people said to one another, "What is this that has come upon the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?"
**12** And a man from there answered and said, "And who is their father?" Therefore it became a proverb: "Is Saul also among the prophets?"
**13** And when he finished prophesying, he came to the high place.
**14** And the uncle of Saul said to him and to his servant, "Where did you go?" And he said, "To seek the donkeys, and when we saw that they were nowhere, we came to Samuel."
**15** And the uncle of Saul said, "Please tell me what Samuel said to you."
**16** And Saul said to his uncle, "He plainly told us that the donkeys had been found." But the matter of the kingship, of which Samuel had spoken, he did not tell him.
**17** And Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah.
**18** And he said to the sons of Israel, "Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: 'I brought Israel up from Egypt, and I delivered you from the hand of Egypt and from the hand of all the kingdoms that were oppressing you.'
**19** But you today have rejected your God, who himself saves you from all your calamities and your distresses, and you have said to him, 'No, but set a king over us.' Now therefore, present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and by your clans."
**20** And Samuel brought near all the tribes of Israel, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken by lot.
**21** And he brought near the tribe of Benjamin by its clans, and the clan of the Matrites was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken. But when they sought him, he could not be found.
**22** And they inquired again of the LORD, "Has the man come here yet?" And the LORD said, "Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage."
**23** And they ran and took him from there, and he stood in the midst of the people, and he was taller than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
**24** And Samuel said to all the people, "Do you see him whom the LORD has chosen, that there is none like him among all the people?" And all the people shouted and said, "Long live the king!"
**25** And Samuel spoke to the people the manner of the kingship, and he wrote it in a scroll and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, each man to his house.
**26** And Saul also went to his house at Gibeah, and the valiant men whose hearts God had touched went with him.
**27** But the sons of worthlessness said, "How can this one save us?" And they despised him and brought him no gift. But he was as one who was silent.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

All three translators agreed on the verse count (27 verses) and narrative structure for this chapter. SOPHIA follows the LOGOS formal-equivalence rendering as the baseline consensus, adopting PNEUMA's phrasing where it demonstrably improves clarity without sacrificing accuracy. Key terms and theological vocabulary were consistently rendered across all three translations.

---
## ⚠️ Disagreement Log

- **EMET:** "And-they-will-ask of-your-welfare and-give to-you two [loaves of]-bread, and-you-shall-receive from-their-hand."
- **LOGOS:** "And they will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, and you shall receive them from their hand."
- **PNEUMA:** "They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you should accept from them."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 5
- **EMET:** "After that you-will-come to-Gibeah of-God [Giv'at ha-Elohim], where [is] the-garrison of-[the]-Philistines. And-it-will-be, when-you-come there to-the..."
- **LOGOS:** "After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is. And it will be, when you come there to the city, that you will ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "After that, you will come to Gibeah of God, where the Philistine garrison is stationed. As you approach the town, you will encounter a procession of p..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 7
- **EMET:** "And-it-will-be when-these signs come to-you, do for-yourself what your-hand finds, for God [is] with-you."
- **LOGOS:** "And it shall be, when these signs come upon you, do for yourself whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you."
- **PNEUMA:** "When these signs are fulfilled in your experience, do whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 8
- **EMET:** "And-you-shall-go-down before-me to-Gilgal, and-behold, I [am]-going-down to-you to-offer-up burnt-offerings, to-sacrifice sacrifices of-peace-offering..."
- **LOGOS:** "And you shall go down before me to Gilgal, and behold, I am coming down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Go down ahead of me to Gilgal. I will come to you there to offer burnt offerings and present fellowship offerings. Wait seven days until I come to you..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 9
- **EMET:** "And-it-was when-he-turned his-shoulder to-go from-with Samuel, and-God turned for-him another heart, and-all these signs came on-that day."
- **LOGOS:** "And it was so, when he turned his shoulder to depart from Samuel, that God gave him another heart, and all these signs came to pass on that day."
- **PNEUMA:** "As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God gave him a changed heart, and all these signs were fulfilled that very day."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 10
- **EMET:** "And-they-came there to-Gibeah, and-behold, a-band of-prophets [was coming] to-meet-him, and-rushed upon-him [the]-spirit of-God, and-he-prophesied in-..."
- **LOGOS:** "And they came there to the hill, and behold, a band of prophets met him, and the spirit of God rushed upon him, and he prophesied in their midst."
- **PNEUMA:** "When they arrived at Gibeah, a band of prophets met him. The Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he prophesied among them."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 11
- **EMET:** "And-it-was, all [who]-knew him from-yesterday and-from-before-that, and-they-saw, and-behold, with-[the]-prophets he-prophesied. And-said the-people e..."
- **LOGOS:** "And it came to pass that all who knew him previously saw, and behold, he was prophesying with the prophets. And the people said to one another, "What ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "When everyone who had known him before saw him prophesying with the prophets, they said to each other, "What has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul ..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 12
- **EMET:** "And-answered a-man from-there and-said, "And-who [is] their-father?" Therefore it-became a-proverb [mashal]: "Is-also Saul among-the-prophets?""
- **LOGOS:** "And a man from there answered and said, "And who is their father?" Therefore it became a proverb: "Is Saul also among the prophets?""
- **PNEUMA:** "A local man spoke up, "And who is their father?" That is how "Is Saul among the prophets?" became a well-known saying."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 13
- **EMET:** "And-he-finished from-prophesying and-came to-the-high-place."
- **LOGOS:** "And when he finished prophesying, he came to the high place."
- **PNEUMA:** "When the prophetic frenzy passed, Saul went to the high place."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 14
- **EMET:** "And-said [the]-uncle of-Saul to-him and-to his-servant, "Where did-you-go?" And-he-said, "To-seek the-donkeys. And-we-saw that-[they were]-not [there]..."
- **LOGOS:** "And the uncle of Saul said to him and to his servant, "Where did you go?" And he said, "To seek the donkeys, and when we saw that they were nowhere, w..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul's uncle asked him and his servant, "Where did you go?" Saul replied, "To look for the donkeys. When we couldn't find them, we went to Samuel.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 15
- **EMET:** "And-said [the]-uncle of-Saul, "Tell me, please, what did-Samuel-say to-you?""
- **LOGOS:** "And the uncle of Saul said, "Please tell me what Samuel said to you.""
- **PNEUMA:** "His uncle pressed, "Tell me — what did Samuel say to you?""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 18
- **EMET:** "And-he-said to-[the]-sons of-Israel, "Thus says YHWH, [the]-God of-Israel: 'I brought-up Israel from-Egypt, and-I-delivered you from-[the]-hand of-Egy..."
- **LOGOS:** "And he said to the sons of Israel, "Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel: 'I brought Israel up from Egypt, and I delivered you from the hand of Egypt..."
- **PNEUMA:** "He addressed the Israelites: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, declares: 'I brought Israel up out of Egypt. I rescued you from the power of E..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 20
- **EMET:** "And-Samuel brought-near all the-tribes of-Israel, and-was-taken [by lot] the-tribe of-Benjamin."
- **LOGOS:** "And Samuel brought near all the tribes of Israel, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken by lot."
- **PNEUMA:** "When Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, the tribe of Benjamin was selected."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 21
- **EMET:** "And-he-brought-near the-tribe of-Benjamin by-its-clans, and-was-taken the-clan of-the-Matrites, and-was-taken Saul son of-Kish. And-they-sought him, b..."
- **LOGOS:** "And he brought near the tribe of Benjamin by its clans, and the clan of the Matrites was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken. But when they soug..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward by clans, and the clan of the Matrites was selected. Finally, Saul son of Kish was selected. But when t..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 22
- **EMET:** "And-they-inquired again of-YHWH, "Has the-man yet come here?" And-said YHWH, "Behold, he is-hiding himself among the-baggage [kelim].""
- **LOGOS:** "And they inquired again of the LORD, "Has the man come here yet?" And the LORD said, "Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.""
- **PNEUMA:** "So they inquired further of the LORD, "Has the man come here?" And the LORD answered, "Yes — he is hiding among the baggage.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 23
- **EMET:** "And-they-ran and-took him from-there. And-he-stood-forth in-[the]-midst of-the-people, and-he-was-taller than-all the-people from-his-shoulder and-upw..."
- **LOGOS:** "And they ran and took him from there, and he stood in the midst of the people, and he was taller than any of the people from his shoulders and upward."
- **PNEUMA:** "They ran and pulled him out from there. When he stood among the people, he towered over everyone from the shoulders up."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 25
- **EMET:** "And-spoke Samuel to-the-people the-manner [mishpat] of-the-kingship [ha-melukah] and-wrote [it] in-a-book [sefer] and-laid-it-up before YHWH. And-Samu..."
- **LOGOS:** "And Samuel spoke to the people the manner of the kingship, and he wrote it in a scroll and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Samuel then explained to the people the rights and duties of kingship. He wrote them down in a document and deposited it before the LORD. Then Samuel ..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 26
- **EMET:** "And-also Saul went to-his-house, to-Gibeah, and-went with-him the-valiant-ones [benei ha-chayil] whose hearts God had-touched."
- **LOGOS:** "And Saul also went to his house at Gibeah, and the valiant men whose hearts God had touched went with him."
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul also went home to Gibeah, accompanied by warriors whose hearts God had touched."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 27
- **EMET:** "But-sons of-worthlessness [benei beliya'al] said, "How shall-this-one save-us?" And-they-despised him and-did-not bring to-him a-gift. But-he-was as-o..."
- **LOGOS:** "But the sons of worthlessness said, "How can this one save us?" And they despised him and brought him no gift. But he was as one who was silent."
- **PNEUMA:** "But some worthless troublemakers said, "How can this man save us?" They despised him and brought him no tribute. But Saul held his peace."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
